purpose: Bounded parallel source qualification for unresolved V2A SOURCE_RECOVERY_CANDIDATE names using materially distinct official free/public spot-market sources.

residual_reconciliation.selection_reason: Official provider surfaces currently expose exact named asset identity plus a public centralized spot market; ambiguous or unsupported residual names remain fail-closed and are not silently substituted.

qualification_requirements: Each source must remain official, free/public, auditable and accessible without private credentials.
Exact asset identity must match the frozen V2A coin_id and symbol; ticker equality alone is insufficient.
Physical qualification must preserve raw response bytes and SHA-256 before normalization.
Provider, pair, endpoint, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser/schema version must be recorded.
Timestamp semantics/timezone and deterministic schema mapping must be explicit.
Duplicate, missing-bucket, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed where exposed.
Observed gaps remain negative evidence and cannot be synthesized, stitched across sources or silently repaired.
Historical coverage/admissibility must be adjudicated under the already-frozen V2A contract without changing denominator, cutoff, methodology, clocks or economics.
Qualification cannot repair prior PIT snapshots or count as prospective scientific evidence.
A clean candidate may only be admitted by a separate read-only adjudication.
